title: Causal Structure in Galaxies: analysis code
description: Analysis code for causal-discovery experiments on galaxy catalogues and cosmological simulations, using the FCIT algorithm via py-tetrad. Processes two observational catalogues (NASA-Sloan Atlas, ALFALFA x NSA) and three cosmological simulations (TNG50, EAGLE, SIMBA), recovers partial ancestral graphs for each, and compares causal structure across codes on a matched variable set.
